PH1.
P16-0088 -- Vista Village Creekside - Pathfinder Silvergate Creekside, LLC
Request for a Site Development Plan to construct 41 apartment units on a 1.47-acre site (APNs 164-205-03, 04, and 10) located south of Vista Village Drive and just south of the Wave Waterpark. The project site is currently vacant. The project proposes four (4) two and three-story buildings, private yard areas and common areas, parking facilities, pedestrian walkways, and associated site improvements. This project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with CEQA Guidelines Section 15332 – In-Fill Development Projects.
Staff Report
DR1.
Downtown Vista Mixed Use
The project applicant, Streetlights Residential, has submitted an application to develop a mixed use project consisting of 14,881 square feet of commercial space and 126 apartment units on the vacant lot at the northeast corner of S. Santa Fe Avenue and Main Street. The proposal include two levels of underground parking, ground floor commercial space and townhome units, and four stories of residential units. The proposed project would be five stories with a height of 60 feet.
